reason: We have run our current system for years and it works well enough; I'm not moving 950 members, our tee sheet and our invoicing to two founders whose first pilot club isn't even live yet. A nice app in our own colours doesn't outweigh the risk of a messy season.
objection: Two people building and supporting it, no club live yet: if they stop or get overwhelmed, I'm the one explaining to the board and 950 members why the tee sheet is down. And it's another few hundred euros a month plus a migration fee on top of what we already pay.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a comparable 18-hole club running it live for a full season without problems, and a clear way to get our data out if they go under.
